book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Mene Ḡihurine Rudaꞌuma
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesu teite radiroteꞌe azaḡa nuꞌa Iesu niro, “Galilea azaḡa nuꞌa Badiꞌa dibuꞌohauꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano Pilatoꞌa zemeha.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Zae zamarone, zeḡe haḡai sauꞌaꞌe Galilea azaḡa ꞌomo haḡaize sauꞌa roꞌanoga ꞌahine, ꞌouge rudaneha rae raꞌehe?
Mene. Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, zae zuni zae haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo mene ḡihurine, zeḡe teige zae niduꞌa rudaꞌuma.
Ebu za edeḡa, Siloama habaꞌano ne hitaganiꞌa fahanadu vaze niduꞌa 18 rudaro. Zae zamarone, zeḡe haḡai sauꞌaꞌe Ierusalema azaḡa niduꞌa haḡaize sauꞌa roꞌanoga rae raꞌehe?
Mene. Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, zae zuni zae haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo mene ḡihurine, zeḡe teige zae niduꞌa rudaꞌuma.”
Figi Ireḡa Huga Oꞌoꞌa Hari Idaidaḡa
Ebu Iesuꞌa hari ꞌahoga idaniro, “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa vaini mebaḡano figi ireḡa ḡoraro. Eꞌe enogano aniꞌa huga nu reꞌoga veize onamiro, rehano huga ꞌahoga mene horoniro.
Eꞌanoꞌo aniꞌa meba ḡianeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa niro, 'E muri uḡidu zamaḡano huga reꞌoga veize arido, rehano hugani ꞌahoga mene horonido. Eꞌanoꞌo udi higanoꞌi! Nougaꞌahi haba daꞌo iriꞌavone tauḡiꞌohe?'
Ebu meba ḡianeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa naenaeniro, 'Vaze boro, ge muri tiba daꞌo bare modoꞌi. Eḡeꞌa ire varahe hoꞌadu mazaḡano busi mumuḡa teadu ḡianiꞌuma.
ꞌOugine, muri tiba enogano manoḡa hudaꞌuma. Mene hudanoꞌidene, udi higonoꞌi.'”
Iesuꞌa Bana Madaḡano Ḡaruga Sauꞌa Roḡaeḡa Fainiro
Bana Madaḡa ꞌahogano Iesuꞌe nu'onu'o neḡano ihoze radiunu.
Ebu eꞌea roḡae ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu. Vine sauꞌaniꞌa ani ragano radu ḡaruga mae beꞌoniro ꞌahine, aniꞌe muri 18 mene edau faraunu.
Iesuꞌa ani horonirotene, ane vaḡe aroga veize hunadu niro, “Roḡae, ḡae ugi ꞌai manoreha.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ꞌevoꞌa ane rana tirotene, ani zogone edau fararo zu Badiꞌa niguniro.

Rehano nu'onu'o neḡa vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaꞌe maḡuniro, mazaḡa Iesuꞌa Bana Madaḡano ugi roḡaeḡa fainiro. Aniꞌa vaze ziro, “Eme mada fuꞌo tiba fare zamaḡano gauiꞌuma. Eꞌanoꞌo ugi azaḡaꞌe eꞌe madaḡano aradu manoriꞌuma, u Bana Madaḡanoꞌe mene ꞌougiꞌuma.”
Ebu Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa naenaeniro, “Za, zama guhi azaḡa! Zae tibatiba zuni Bana Madaḡano boromakauze ga donikize maḡuzeonoꞌo fuiꞌe bunadu tutuze onamadu vu gagoziniꞌohe.
Tena Aberahamo mariga raꞌeteꞌe roḡaeḡa ꞌadiꞌe nougiꞌuma? Aniꞌe Sataniꞌa muri 18 ogoru tiro. Bana Madaḡano ani fuiꞌe bunogaꞌe mene idaḡahe?”
Iesuꞌa ꞌouge reirotene, ani agiroharoteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe mazagaroziro, u vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaꞌe aneꞌa haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa manomano niduꞌa uꞌano, matuꞌiro.
Badiꞌaꞌa Zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe moneo Hari Idaidaniro
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌetaꞌaꞌe nagini heuḡa? Naginio idaniꞌuma?
Aꞌe Kuava
maḡa komeꞌa tiba vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa madu mebaḡano ḡoraroteꞌe heuḡa. Ebu maḡa komeꞌa eꞌeꞌa ḡuhuradu ire boro reirotene, hitagano niniꞌa rafiu aradu ezagano neze ogoraro.”
Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌetaꞌaꞌe naginio idaniꞌuma?
Aꞌe isiti heuḡa. Roḡaeꞌa isiti tahiḡa madu ꞌuvahuḡa ḡehaḡa teite mirune tibunirotene ꞌuvahu niduꞌa ubararo.”
Ibiheta Kokosiḡa
Iesuꞌa Ierusalema onameꞌeteꞌea, habaꞌahabaꞌano zu neḡaneḡano ihoze onamiro.
Ebu vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, Badiꞌaꞌa vaze tahiḡa daꞌo ḡaboziꞌumahe?” Iesuꞌa naenaeziro,
“Ḡabone hidihi roꞌidene, ibiheta kokosiḡa diuḡoga veize inare hunoꞌi. Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, vaze ḡehaḡaꞌe eꞌe diuḡihi reꞌuma rehano, mene idaraꞌuma.
Ne vazeḡaniꞌa iḡunadu ibiheta haraune, zaꞌe enona edanadu toketokereꞌenaꞌa ꞌahige uminiꞌuma, 'Vaze boro, ibiheta vavaꞌoꞌi!' Rehano ani naenaeziꞌuma, 'E za noumanoꞌo arataꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa.'
Ebu za ꞌahige reꞌuma, 'Eme ḡae teite ogaro zu gagiro ebu ḡaꞌe ibio ihofiro.'
Rehano ani naenaeziꞌuma, 'Za noumanoꞌo arataꞌaꞌe e aḡuꞌa. Za, haḡai sauꞌa azaḡa, eḡe mazaonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi!'
Ebu za Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano Aberahamo, Isako, Iakobo zu peroveta azaḡa niduꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe zu zaꞌe enona mae feuzeꞌeteꞌe horoziꞌuma. ꞌOugadu zaꞌe niaꞌuma zu ḡononeze atitiꞌuma.
Iuda mene azaḡaniꞌa madaꞌa iteꞌeteꞌe moneonoꞌo zu madaꞌa zubureꞌeteꞌe moneonoꞌo zu haba niduꞌaonoꞌo aradu Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ogau tiburaꞌuma.
Hube hune, vaze ibiꞌaꞌe ḡonaga reꞌuma ebu vaze ḡonagaꞌe ibiꞌa reꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa Ierusalema uꞌano Niaro
Eꞌe madaḡano Farisea azaḡa nuꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu niro, “ꞌAdanoꞌo vaḡinadu haba ꞌahoga onamoꞌi, mazaḡa kini Herodaꞌa ḡamihi raꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Aniꞌe butu ḡuniḡa soꞌosoꞌoḡa. Ani vaḡe onamadu ꞌahige noꞌi, 'E mada mene faḡano
vine sauꞌa hegoze buziꞌuma zu ugi azaḡa faiziꞌuma, ebu hena
eḡe gau niduꞌa haḡae hauḡiꞌuma.'
Naginiꞌa eḡe mazao fureraune zuni, e izidi, ohoḡore, iḡano zu mada nu eḡe ibio onamiꞌuma, onamo Ierusalemao feuriꞌuma. Mazaḡa peroveta azaḡaꞌe Ierusalema habaꞌa enogano mene rudaꞌuma.

O, Ierusalema, Ierusalema, zaꞌa peroveta azaḡa zimiro, zu Badiꞌaꞌa tuḡuziroteꞌe azaḡa hadi hina zimi ruziro. Kokorokuꞌa isaḡa zamaḡano ubuga gugubeꞌeteꞌe teige, eḡeꞌa ḡae ḡehaḡa zae taufihi reiro, rehano zaꞌe mene uratinu!
Ḡianoꞌi, neze fahadu mae modiꞌuma. Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, zaꞌe e mene bare horohiꞌuma, onamo zaeꞌa raenaꞌa, 'Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano areꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune,' rae reiteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa meꞌuma.”
